title: Changelog
admin_description: Write and publish updates for the FullParty community.
empty: No updates have been published yet.
load_error: The changelog could not be loaded. Please try again.
since_choice: Since the last changelog — after {from}, through {to}
versions_locked: This entry has been published. Its version range is permanently preserved.
range_unavailable: A range is available after a changelog has been published and a newer version is deployed.
translation_help: English is required. Other languages are optional and fall back to English. Add both a title and body for each translation.
edit_live: Saving updates this published entry immediately.
publish_confirm: Publish this saved changelog for everyone to read?
unpublish_confirm: Hide this changelog from readers? You can publish it again later.

errors.no_version: No valid deployed version is available. Check storage/app/version.json before creating or publishing a changelog.
errors.version_changed: The deployed version or latest changelog has changed. Refresh the version selection, review the range, and save before publishing.
errors.no_range: There is no newer version to cover since the last changelog.
errors.older_version: The deployed version is older than the latest published changelog.
errors.conflict: Another admin changed this entry. Reload the page before saving or publishing.
errors.translation_required: Each translation needs both a title and a non-empty body.
